chars.SON: SON: a Moroccan man in his late 20s with short black hair and a neat short beard, wearing a brand-new navy blue suit, white shirt, no tie
chars.DAD: DAD: a Moroccan man about 55, bald on top with grey hair on the sides and a thick grey moustache, wearing a beige djellaba over a brown sweater
chars.BRIDE: BRIDE: a Moroccan woman in her mid-20s with long wavy brown hair, wearing an emerald green satin kaftan with a gold belt
chars.HERMOM: HERMOM: a Moroccan woman about 50, wearing a burgundy velvet kaftan and a white headscarf

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a traditional Moroccan salon in Casablanca with long sedari sofas and zellige, DAD freezes in the doorway staring in shock at a framed photo of a young woman on the wall, while SON next to him holds flowers and a chocolate box, smiling and confused; HERMOM welcomes them with open arms. Full-screen vertical 2D illustration, main subjects in the centre, calm background at the edges, no text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of DAD sitting on a Moroccan sofa, sweating and wide-eyed, nervously staring at a framed family photo on a side table, gripping his djellaba, tense. Full-screen vertical 2D illustration, main subjects in the centre, calm background at the edges, no text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: SON leans over and whispers to DAD on a Moroccan sedari sofa, SON curious and suspicious, DAD avoids his eyes and forces an awkward smile. Full-screen vertical 2D illustration, main subjects in the centre, calm background at the edges, no text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: BRIDE walks into the Moroccan salon smiling, carrying a silver tea tray with a teapot and glasses; SON in the foreground looks at her happily; DAD on the sofa still looking down. Full-screen vertical 2D illustration, main subjects in the centre, calm background at the edges, no text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: BRIDE stops dead in the salon, looking straight at DAD in shock, the silver tea tray slipping from her hands and teapot and glasses falling mid-air; DAD on the sofa frozen and pale, both faces clearly visible. Full-screen vertical 2D illustration, main subjects in the centre, calm background at the edges, no text.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: HERMOM sitting on a Moroccan sofa turning pale with her hand on her chest, staring at DAD; DAD sweating heavily, mouth open, not knowing what to say; spilled tea glasses on the carpet. Full-screen vertical 2D illustration, main subjects in the centre, calm background at the edges, no text.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: BRIDE in a Moroccan hallway covering her face with her hands, crying and hiding behind a carved wooden door, emotional. Full-screen vertical 2D illustration, main subjects in the centre, calm background at the edges, no text.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Awkward silence in the Moroccan salon: SON confused looking from one person to another, DAD staring at the floor, HERMOM forcing a fake smile, flowers and chocolate box lying on the table. Full-screen vertical 2D illustration, main subjects in the centre, calm background at the edges, no text.
